facts.fact: The ministry of finance's second and third quarter 2025 PFM report names one council, Basse Area Council, as operating a Digital Tax Collection System; no total of councils is given in the passage (document dated September 2025 and read by searching revenue terms).
The report states Janjanbureh Area Council has no Digital Tax Collection System and Brikama Area Council has no digital platform for collections; dated by the report's September 2025 publication.
The report states Brikama Area Council has no digital platform for collections and only a small proportion of taxpayers pay the bank directly, dated by the report's September 2025 publication.
The report says Basse Area Council's Digital Tax Collection System runs beside its IFMIS accounting system and that integration between the two is pending.

Kuntaur Area Council plans to pilot digital revenue collection by the fourth quarter, with a budget line already allocated, though equipment procurement is in progress and consultancy costs are high; dated by the report's September 2025 publication.
